marketing.testimonialsSub: They had doubts — now they have Google reviews and smiles
marketing.faq1Q: How does the prize wheel work?
marketing.faq1A: Customers scan a QR code in your venue to access an online wheel. Before spinning, they complete an action you choose — Google review, social follow, etc. Then they spin for a prize you defined. Simple to set up, fun to use, effective for reviews and loyalty.
marketing.faq2Q: How fast will I see results?
marketing.faq2A: Results show from day one. Many businesses get their first Google reviews the same evening. After a month, the impact is even stronger. Your dashboard tracks performance in real time.
marketing.faq3Q: Does it work with my existing tools?
marketing.faq3A: Yes. The QR-based game complements your current stack — POS, CRM, loyalty programs — and works alongside your agency or community manager.
marketing.faq4Q: How do I set it up?
marketing.faq4A: Sign up online, configure your wheel, prizes, and branding, download your QR, and place it in-store. You can go live in under 10 minutes.
